guarantees.claim: rx_in_maj is the majority vote of rx_sync, rx_sync_q1, and rx_sync_q2.
rx_in_mx selects rx_in_maj when rxnf_enable is high, otherwise selects rx_sync.
rx_in selects tx_out when sys_loopback=1, 1'b1 when line_loopback=1, and rx_in_mx otherwise.
rx_fifo_wvalid is asserted only when rx_valid is high and both event_rx_frame_err and event_rx_parity_err are low.
uart_rx instance connects .rx(rx_in) and .parity_enable(reg2hw.ctrl.parity_en.q), driving rx_valid, rx_fifo_data, event_rx_frame_err, event_rx_parity_err, and idle.

prim_fifo_sync instance connects wvalid_i to rx_fifo_wvalid, wdata_i to rx_fifo_data, rready_i to reg2hw.rdata.re, rdata_o to uart_rdata, rvalid_o to rx_fifo_rvalid, depth_o to rx_fifo_depth, clr_i to uart_fifo_rxrst; full_o and err_o are left unconnected.

assumptions.claim: uart_rx module generates event_rx_frame_err and event_rx_parity_err synchronously with rx_valid.
assumptions.risk: rx_fifo_wvalid may incorrectly gate data, causing spurious writes or loss of valid data.

assumptions.claim: rxnf_enable, sys_loopback, and line_loopback are stable during reception and do not toggle mid-character.
assumptions.risk: rx_in may glitch, corrupting bits and leading to false frame/parity errors.

assumptions.claim: CSR fields reg2hw.ctrl.parity_en.q and parity_odd.q provide the correct parity configuration before reception starts.
assumptions.risk: incorrect parity checking may cause false parity error detections or missed errors.

assumptions.claim: RxFifoDepth is a legal parameter supported by prim_fifo_sync and fits the resource constraints.
assumptions.risk: FIFO behavior becomes undefined, leading to data corruption or functional failure.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.rdata.re is only asserted when rx_fifo_rvalid is high, preventing an empty read from the FIFO.
assumptions.risk: err_o unconnected; an empty read could go undetected, potentially yielding stale data.

assumptions.claim: uart_fifo_rxrst is asserted appropriately to clear the FIFO when required.
assumptions.cond: after a reset or error event
assumptions.risk: stale data may remain in the FIFO, causing incorrect reads.

assumptions.claim: rx_sync, rx_sync_q1, and rx_sync_q2 are adequately synchronized and represent stable sampled values of the external RX line.
assumptions.risk: metastability or incorrect sampling can cause false edges and corrupt the majority vote.

uncertain_points.claim: prim_fifo_sync full_o and err_o are left unconnected; overflow or error conditions are not detected or handled in this chunk.
uncertain_points.cond: when FIFO becomes full or an illegal operation occurs
uncertain_points.risk: data loss from overflow or undetected FIFO errors compromising data integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: In sys_loopback mode with parity_enable=1, uart_rx may assert parity errors on looped data, causing rx_fifo_wvalid to de-assert and data to be lost. The design does not bypass error checking for loopback.
uncertain_points.risk: loopback test data loss, functional failure during loopback operations.

uncertain_points.claim: rx_fifo_wready from prim_fifo_sync is connected to rx_fifo_wready but is not used in this chunk to gate rx_fifo_wvalid or throttle the receiver; backpressure might be missing.
uncertain_points.cond: when FIFO is full and cannot accept writes
uncertain_points.risk: data loss due to overflow because the receiver continues to assert writes.

uncertain_points.claim: rx_fifo_wvalid is a combinational expression of rx_valid and error flags; misalignment between these signals could cause glitched writes.
uncertain_points.cond: timing skew between rx_valid and error flags
uncertain_points.risk: spurious FIFO entries or missed write opportunities.
